messages:
maria: Quick check — launching a mini test for the pricing calculator copy + webinar CTA routing today. I pushed an updated FAQ snippet to the doc: https://docs.redwood.com/sheets/pricing-calc-draft

devon: Thanks — linking it in the launch checklist. Which CTA variants are we routing to the webinar form vs demo request?

maria: Variant A -> webinar (low friction), Variant B -> demo (sales-qual). We want to measure % that convert to trial after webinar follow-up.

ashley: Suggest we include a tiny inline estimator (tokens per month) to reduce dropoff. People love quick numbers. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

kevin: Agreed. Can we keep estimator client-side to avoid extra API calls? Simple JS slider that maps to our metering buckets. I sketched this: ```js
// pseudo mapping
const buckets = ["Free", "Starter", "Scale", "Enterprise"];
function estimate(tokens) { return buckets[Math.min(Math.floor(tokens/50000), buckets.length-1)]; }
```

samir: Nice. For the FAQ copy, I tightened the tier names a bit — replaced "Scale" with "Performance" to be clearer about latency/throughput expectations. That might affect the calculator text.

maria: Hmm open to that rename but ops asked to avoid too many renames pre-launch. Can we A/B test the name only in the calculator UI (frontend label) and keep canonical tier names in the product docs for now?

devon: That's doable. Frontend toggles per experiment flag. I can wire a quick flag in the launch config. Example: `X_EXP_CALC_TIER_LABEL=performance_alternative`

ashley: For measurement: we'll track funnel events `pricing_calc_open`, `estimator_submit`, `cta_click` with properties `variant`, `tier_label`. Also tie `cta_click` to `inbound_channel` (webinar vs demo).

webinar-bot: Reminder — webinar registration page linked in the doc needs UTM params for attribution. Use `?utm_source=pricing_flow&utm_campaign=calc_test_may`

kevin: One last ask: can we show a tiny micro-benchmark blurb under "Performance" tier — e.g., "~20ms median token latency on p4-like infra" — copy is approximate, just to signal suitability for low-latency apps.

maria: Draft copy pushed: "Performance — for latency-sensitive applications. Typical median token latency ~20–40ms depending on model and infra." Please flag any legal/accuracy concerns.

samir: Looks fine. I'll run it by infra to confirm numbers aren't misleading.

devon: Launch checklist updated and feature flag created. Rolling out to 20% NSW geo at 14:00 UTC, then 100% if no regressions.

maria: Perfect. I'll coordinate a short launch note and a webinar reminder email schedule. Thanks team! :thumbsup:
